name: kh-uaf
description: KH UAF provides opt-in domain and workflow skills. Ordinary clear requests run directly or load only the matching domain skill; routing audits, token optimization, credential safety, memory, Goal, and orchestration load only on concrete triggers and stay silent unless blocked or requested.

interface.shortDescription: Personal skillbook with lightweight semantic routing.
interface.longDescription: KH UAF packages host-readable workflow skills, optional runtime gates, scoped memory, token telemetry, role orchestration, GoalState, progress state, and quality checks. For ordinary clear work, answer directly or load only the matching domain skill without reading or narrating routing internals. Routing audits are explicit or governed-only; token optimization requires a reducible payload; credential safety requires actual secret handling. Before any Git executable, KH runs a filesystem-only workspace gate against the exact target. Non-Git targets run no Git/GitHub commands or retries.
defaultPrompt: Review this repository and identify the highest-risk issues before making changes.
Help me plan a new workflow, ask the necessary questions, and wait for approval before implementation.
Format this SQL without changing behavior, then explain the verification evidence.
